vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: privacy-policy
Version: 2.4.0

The skill bundle is a legitimate privacy policy generator that uses a bash script (scripts/privacy.sh) to produce text templates for GDPR and CCPA compliance. The script safely processes user-provided arguments like company name and email to populate static templates and does not perform any network requests, file system modifications, or sensitive data access. While there are minor inconsistencies between the command list in SKILL.md and the actual script implementation, no malicious intent or security vulnerabilities were found.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent: a privacy-policy generator whose instructions and included shell script produce policy text and do not request unrelated credentials, external downloads, or suspicious system access.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (privacy policy generator, GDPR/CCPA) match the included assets: SKILL.md documents generation commands and a local scripts/privacy.sh that builds privacy policy content. There are no unrelated environment variables, binaries, or external services required.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md lists simple generation commands (generate, gdpr, ccpa, app, website, audit) that are implemented by the included shell script. The instructions do not direct the agent to read unrelated system files, harvest environment variables, or transmit data to unexpected endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no external downloads. The only executable is a bundled Bash script (scripts/privacy.sh) which runs locally. No archives or remote extraction are involved.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required env vars or credentials. The script accepts company/email/website parameters and uses default placeholders; it does not reference or require secrets or other services.

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a straightforward privacy-policy generator implemented as a local shell script. Before installing or running it: (1) remember generated policies are for reference only — consult legal counsel before publishing; (2) review the full script content yourself if you can (the provided snippet was truncated in the display); (3) avoid passing sensitive secrets (API keys, passwords, full payment card data) as command-line arguments to the script because command-line arguments can be exposed in process listings or logs; (4) verify the BytesAgain feedback URL and trustworthiness if you plan to follow links; and (5) if you will allow the agent to execute bundled scripts, ensure the agent execution environment is appropriately sandboxed (no sensitive host files or credentials mounted). Otherwise the package is coherent with its stated purpose.
